name: chapman_kolmogorov
caption: Chapman–Kolmogorov max |T(kτ) − T(τ)^k| at the primary lag. The dashed line is the pre-registered threshold 0.15. Every eligible cell is above it: the MSM is not Markovian at lag 1 on this sample.
